title: Bus tour through Spain and France
summary: The group flew to Barcelona and then did one-nighters by bus through France to Paris and Belgium, seeing the countryside.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: But any -- we went on, left there, and we went down to -- no, I think we played Zurich. Then we went from Zurich down to Barcelona. We flew down to Barcelona. And then after we played Barcelona, we took a bus and came all -- it was a wonderful trip. We came by bus. It was one nighters all up through France, all the way back into Paris, and then we went -- also went to Belgium.

And it was nice. It was really nice. We got to see all the countryside and everything and traveling like. Today, the way they travel today by plane, you don't get to see anything, and you spend most of your time in the airports, and
you're always staying at some place outside of the town. But when you have a bus, it's much easier to leave when you get ready and -- and stop and eat and -- it was a lot of fun.
